svg.title: harness-evals at a glance
svg.desc: You bring a use case (tasks, checks, gates), your harnesses behind adapters, and a frozen setup naming the model. harness-evals runs every harness for k trials, grades each run, summarizes success with an interval, pass^k, cost and latency, and compares two harnesses to decide: adopt, reject or inconclusive. Runs are saved as episodes.jsonl and manifest.json.
svg.text: From a use case to a decision
You bring tasks and harnesses. harness-evals runs them on one frozen setup and decides.
tasks, their checks, the bar to clear
what ran and what was held fixed
agent misses the bar: violations = 2, needs ≤ 0

text.tspan: harness-evals never calls a model or runs your harness.
Your adapter does; the library grades what the adapter observed.
